summary: Phase 0 test pass. Backend: 21/21 pytest tests green — public reseller endpoints return 200 without auth, protected reseller endpoints return 401 without auth and 200 with the demo Bearer token, and every VPS plan under /reseller/vps/plans has a numeric vcpus parsed from plan_id (e.g. s-2vcpu-4gb -> 2). Frontend logged-out flows are correct: /vps, /hosting, /dns-manager and /domains hide the wallet chip and Test-mode/dry-run banner, hide the 'Your …' owner sections, Deploy/Get-hosting/Register CTAs redirect logged-out visitors to /sign-in, /dns-manager is protected, home renders in light theme (no `dark` class), no Register/Transfer-in tab toggle, 'Search privately' button present, and 'top up with crypto' copy is in the trust bar. Logged-IN flows (VPS wallet chip / dry-run banner / Deploy modal / Cmd-K navigation / mobile bottom tabs / return-path) COULD NOT BE VERIFIED — the demo user gets forcibly redirected to /account-setting immediately after login (see RCA below), so every navigation to /vps or /dashboard bounces back to /account-setting. This appears to be pre-existing behaviour of the axios interceptor rather than a Phase 0 regression, but it now blocks the Phase 0 logged-in acceptance criteria and needs to be resolved before those items can be re-verified. Cloudflare 429 on the Vite dev preview also caused occasional blank pages during rapid navigation; tests were re-run sequentially with waits.

ui_bugs.issue: After the auto-search fires from the ?value= query param, no result rows (Available/Taken/Register) rendered within a 10s wait window on the logged-out first-load. Owner sections and wallet chips correctly stayed hidden, but the acceptance criterion 'results render' could not be confirmed. May be a slow /reseller/domains/search call behind CF or missing loading/error UI — please verify manually.

integration_issues.issue: Immediately after a successful /api/v1/auth/login, the app lands on /account-setting instead of `path || '/'`. Any subsequent client-side navigation (goto /vps, /dashboard, Cmd-K -> Domains, mobile bottom-tabs -> Domains/Hosting) also ends at /account-setting. Root cause is almost certainly the response interceptor in /app/frontend/src/api/client.js lines 63-64: a 400 with body.redirect=true triggers redirectAPIKey() which navigate()s to /account-setting?tab=api-key. The demo user's latestApiKey is null so some post-login GET (very likely an /api/v1/... call that requires x-api-key) returns 400 {redirect:true} and the interceptor hijacks the SPA. This blocks verification of: (a) VPS wallet chip [data-testid=user-wallet-chip], (b) dry-run banner [data-testid=dry-run-banner], (c) Deploy Offshore VPS modal, (d) Cmd-K -> Domains/DNS/Hosting navigation, (e) mobile bottom-tabs Domains/Hosting, (f) return-path (/vps -> /sign-in -> /vps).

action_items: Investigate why demo@nameword.local triggers the axios 400+redirect=true interceptor path right after login (check network tab for the first request that returns {redirect:true} — likely an API-key-gated endpoint hit unconditionally after mount). Either (a) skip that call when latestApiKey is null, or (b) only redirect via redirectAPIKey when the user has actively requested an API-key protected feature. Without this the Phase 0 logged-in acceptance criteria (wallet chip, dry-run banner, Deploy modal, Cmd-K nav, bottom-tabs, return-path) cannot be reached.

Verify /domains?value=... renders result rows on first load without an already-authenticated session — during testing no Register buttons appeared within 10s (may be slow API, missing loading state, or CF 429 on the Vite dev preview).
Optional: consider seeding an API key on the demo user in the memory doc so testing can bypass this interceptor.
Note: many parallel Vite module requests hit Cloudflare 429 during rapid page loads (as flagged in the request). Consider a production build for reliable UI testing.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/api/client.js: response interceptor treats ANY 400 with `redirect:true` as a global redirect to /account-setting?tab=api-key — this is too aggressive and hijacks the SPA for any API-key-required endpoint that is fetched implicitly on page mount. Scope the redirect to explicit user actions, or check the request URL before redirecting.

/app/frontend/src/pages/front-admin/UserManagement/AccountSettings.jsx line 46-51: useEffect calls navigate('/account-setting', {replace:true}) unconditionally on tab-param change — it strips the ?tab=... query even when the user just navigated in with a valid tab (e.g. from redirectAPIKey which sets ?tab=api-key). Guard with `if (tab)` only, and don't re-navigate when already on that URL.
/app/frontend/src/hocs/Protected.jsx correctly stores return path in localStorage 'path' — good. Phase 0 implementation matches spec.
Backend reseller controller: withVcpus parser is correct across plans; consider unit-testing the helper directly so a plan-id format change (e.g. c-4vcpu-8gb) is caught.

(2) On 390px viewport, /dashboard must render [data-testid=bottom-tabs] and Domains/Hosting tabs must navigate to /domains and /hosting. Vite dev + CF causes 429 blank pages, so navigate sequentially with 6-10s waits.
rca of the issue: Post-login forced redirect to /account-setting: /app/frontend/src/context/AuthContext.jsx.login() correctly does `navigate(localStorage.getItem('path') || '/')` when the user is verified. However the shared axios instance has a response interceptor (client.js lines 51-68) that, on a 400 response whose body contains `redirect:true`, calls redirectAPIKey() which unconditionally navigates to `/account-setting?tab=api-key`. The demo user's latestApiKey is null, so the first API-key-gated GET fired after mount (probably a session/account/API-key metadata call) responds with 400 {redirect:true} and hijacks the SPA. Mitigation: scope the interceptor redirect to explicit user actions (e.g. only when the failing request is one the user intentionally initiated for an API-key feature), or bail out when `latestApiKey` is null instead of redirecting.
